v1_canonicalization: Cases sorted by id; recursively sort object keys; preserve array order; compact UTF-8 JSON with final LF
inherited_v1_fields: tests/p2-jev/rubric.v1.json tools.*.fields; every V1 field retained unless an explicit migration is recorded in field_migrations
coverage_policy: The 24 additions cover nine reviewed concepts: present-invalid, catalog-resolved, derived, documented default, unresolved semantic role, range value, possible typo, explicit conflict resolution, and request versus device permission. Coverage assertions are semantic and case-scoped; do not require artificial positive/negative states for every field. Venue room dimensions require both missing and present examples within venue report/discussion cases. LED assembly-unit dimensions must be sourced from exact dimensions already stated in inherited LED-004 and LED-007 plus a missing-dimensions case. The added brightness_nit field requires a supplied-value case and the separate AV coverage cases include horizontal-only and axis-confusion states.
sufficiency_policy: sufficient means: Whether this parameter’s current information is usable for this parameter in the current target calculation/operation. sufficient=true includes recording a raw value when the operation does not require interpreting it. sufficient=false means the field itself cannot support that parameter's target operation yet. It does not by itself require clarification: clarify only when clarification.reasons explicitly records a user-actionable blocker. valid reports value validity separately, so valid=null may coexist with sufficient=true for uninterpreted record text, and valid=false requires sufficient=false. possible_typo preserves the exact raw user value and leaves validity unknown; do not silently correct it. semantic_role=unresolved preserves a present value whose meaning within the operation is unknown and remains insufficient until resolved. conflict.resolution is null or an explicit utterance substring. Clarification and intent_ambiguous are independent decisions. For clarification reasons, optional any_of encodes OR between alternatives and AND among qualified fields within each alternative. parameters lists affected missing/blocking fields, and may omit already-present fields used by an alternative. Per-parameter sufficiency does not alone determine request readiness; only clarification reasons record user-actionable blockers.
metadata_retained: The inherited 120 cases must preserve their V1 id/category/mode/case_type/tags/user_utterance/provenance exactly. Added cases must use the same metadata contract and distinct ids/utterances.
source_distribution_policy: Report source counts and parameter counts; counts overlap across case-level tool selection and per-parameter states.

clarification_reason_format.semantics: When present, any_of is an OR of alternatives; each inner array is an AND of qualified parameter names. A parameter satisfies an alternative only when its current state is sufficient=true and valid is not false. parameters records the affected missing/blocking fields and need not be the union of all names in any_of (an alternative may include already-present fields). Parameters remain per-field states; their sufficiency does not alone determine request readiness. Only clarification.reasons record user-actionable blockers.
clarification_reason_format.validation: any_of must be a non-empty array of non-empty arrays of distinct qualified parameter names, all present in that case expected.parameters; outer alternatives and inner members must be unique.
